decisions.reason: The cloud contact centre service was launched only in 2023 and fits the firm's unified communications and hybrid cloud strategy; its prospects are still uncertain but it costs little to keep on partner cloud platforms, so the option should stay open while results come in.

The call number routing platform runs on the firm's owned voice network and has its own website page, which signals commitment; it is cheap to keep and too new for its value to be judged, so keeping it as a growth option is sensible.
